responsibility: This header declares the public interface to GCC internal functions. It defines auxiliary enums for special IFN argument encodings such as UNIQUE, GOACC_LOOP, and GOACC_REDUCTION; exposes name, flag, fnspec, and direct-optab metadata accessors; declares support and classification predicates; and provides the expansion APIs that lower IFN calls to RTL. It is the main interface layer through which middle-end passes reason about and emit compiler-synthesized internal-function calls.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/internal-fn.def, which lists the internal functions, and gcc/internal-fn.cc, which implements their behavior, this header exposes the shared types, enums, metadata accessors, predicates, and expansion declarations used by other GCC code.
